:::{#def-local-minimizer}
#### Local minimizer

Let $A \subseteq \reals^p$
and let $f : A \to \reals$ be a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function).
A point $x^* \in A$ is a **local minimizer** of $f$
if there is a number $\tolin > 0$
such that $f(x^*) \le f(x)$
[for all](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-universal-quantifier) $x \in A$
in the [open ball](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd#def-ball) $\ball{x^*}{\tolin}$
of radius $\tolin$ around $x^*$.

:::
